gaps.title: Document inline opening and viewing capability
gaps.jtbd: When a user finds a document in the search results, I want to open and view the document directly in the application, so that I can inspect its contents without downloading the file first.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a found document in the catalog search results, When the user clicks the open/view action, Then the document content opens in an inline viewer.
Given a document ID, When requesting inline document viewing from the API, Then the server returns the document with inline content headers.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: Brief point 4 explicitly states 'Найденный документ должен открываться и скачиваться' (found documents must be openable and downloadable), but the current implementation only supports downloading.

gaps.title: Catalog search results pagination
gaps.jtbd: When a user searches or browses the document catalog, I want search results to be paginated, so that large sets of document records are loaded and displayed efficiently.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query returning multiple document results, When requesting search results from the API, Then page and size query parameters are supported.
Given catalog search results exceeding page capacity, When viewing results in the frontend, Then pagination controls are provided to navigate pages.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: a public or enterprise document catalog list/search endpoint standardly requires pagination to handle large document sets efficiently.
